choice: git_head runs `git symbolic-ref --quiet --short HEAD`: exit 0 gives the branch, exit 1 means a detached HEAD, any other exit status means no repository. A timeout or a git that cannot run raises GitError, which the poller shows as a banner over the last view; `remote get-url origin` is treated the same way.
context: The panel called a freshly initialized repository 'not a git repository'. A review then found that a git timeout took the same path.
rejected: `git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD`: fails on an unborn branch and cannot tell that case from a missing repository. Returning 'not a repository' on a timeout: a slow repository flipped to the empty state and back.
title: `git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD` fails in a repository without commits
